fact.en:
What is a conservative collision?

It is a collision where mechanical energy, the energy of motion and position, is kept and not turned into heat or sound.

Unsa ang conservative collision?

Kini mao ang collision diin ang mechanical energy, ang enerhiya sa paglihok ug posisyon, mapabilin ug dili mahimong init o tingog.

fact.bis: Ang Adlaw adunay inner ug outer layers. Ang core naa sa tunga-tunga. Ang photosphere mao ang surface nga atong makita gikan sa Earth.

accepted.reason: Layer overview, central core and visible photosphere separately named. Removes redundant makita without losing visibility; both blind readers support structure. Final source/lexical adjudication: Photosphere visible surface is not solid crust or invitation to gaze at Sun; tunga locates central interior correctly.

fact.tl: Ang mga pure metals ay naglalaman lamang ng isang uri ng metal atom na nakaayos sa mga layer na maaaring mag-slide sa isa't isa, kaya sila ay malleable.

fact.en: Magnesium is in Group IIA of the Periodic Table, which means it has two valence electrons that can be delocalized.

accepted.reason: Definition and two stage descriptions separated; own DNA explicitly belongs to cell. Both blind readers favor named stages and DNA referent. Final source/lexical adjudication: Interphase contains S-phase copying plus growth; not copying throughout all interphase or every mature cell dividing.

fact.en: Meiosis involves two divisions: Meiosis I separates homologous chromosomes, and Meiosis II separates sister chromatids, resulting in four haploid cells.

fact.bis: Ang meiosis adunay duha ka divisions: gibulag sa Meiosis I ang homologous chromosomes, ug gibulag sa Meiosis II ang sister chromatids, nga moresulta sa upat ka haploid cells.

fact.en: Meiosis involves two divisions: Meiosis I separates homologous chromosomes, and Meiosis II separates sister chromatids, resulting in four haploid cells.

accepted.reason: Parallel stage sentences distinguish homologous chromosomes from sister chromatids; final sentence attributes four haploid products to both divisions together. Final source/lexical adjudication: OpenStax sequence yields four haploid products overall, including polar bodies; not four equally sized functional ova.
